articles.author: Rahul Bhatt
articles.description:
DX-First Thinking: Why I Added @EnableTenantIsolation to My Spring Boot Starter


Day 3 of building multi-tenant-springboot-starter was less about code, more about mindset.
I wanted developers to switch between DATABASE, SCHEMA, and SHARED isolation strategies for tenants. The default Spring Boot way would be 
application.yml:
tenant:
  strategy: DATABASE

That works, but I asked myself:
“What would it look like if Spring had built this?”
So I created:
@EnableTenantIsolation(strategy = TenantIsolationStrategy.SCHEMA)

💡 This annotation uses ImportBeanDefinitionRegistrar and EnvironmentAware to inject the tenant.strategy key into the Spring Environment — before anything binds.
What I learned:
@import(...)
The BEAN_CONTAINER trick in JPA is mandatory when manually wiring multiple EntityManagerFactoryBeans — without it, entity scanning breaks
Key Takeaway:
Tomorrow: schema-per-tenant Hibernate integration.
Repo: github.com/rahul-s-bhatt/multi-tenant-springboot-starter
Follow for more build-in-public logs ✨
articles.title: Day 3 : DX-First Thinking: Why I Added @EnableTenantIsolation to My Spring Boot Starter

I used to be an Nginx fan. Had it running everywhere - personal projects, client sites, production servers. The config files made sense once you learned them, and it was rock solid.

That's it. Three lines. HTTPS included. Certificates auto-generated. HTTP/2 enabled.

articles.author: Madhav
articles.description:
VoiceReach is a voice message broadcasting tool that lets users send a single typed message to multiple recipients via automated phone calls. The app uses a Text-to-Speech (TTS) API to convert the message into a realistic voice and then places calls using Twilio to deliver the audio. Designed for quick announcements, invitations, or alerts, VoiceReach eliminates the need for repetitive manual calls, making communication faster and more efficient. Built with Node.js, Express, and a simple HTML/CSS frontend, it's a powerful yet user-friendly solution for voice-based outreach.
GitHub repo - https://github.com/madhavdandona123/murf-ai
VoiceReach has powerful real-world applications for anyone needing to deliver voice messages to multiple people quickly and reliably. Community leaders, school administrators, event organizers, political campaigners, and small businesses can use it to send announcements, alerts, or invitations without making manual calls. It’s especially useful for reaching people who may not regularly check texts or emails—such as elderly recipients or rural communities. Compared to traditional methods like group calls or bulk SMS, VoiceReach improves efficiency by automating the process with natural-sounding voice and delivering it through a personal phone call, which feels more direct and urgent. It reduces human effort, saves time, and increases the likelihood that important messages are heard.
articles.title: VoiceReach [Murf AI Coding Challenge 2]
